messages:
Ken: Morning — quick precut pulse. Cut window in ~3h. Status: train at green but we have a flaky canary on model-v2 routing and a GPU driver patch queued. What I did: validated rollback paths and updated cut checklist.

Sara: Can confirm canary failures are timing out at 95%ile for short tails. Investigating a possible KV-cache regression.

Jamal: I picked up the GPU driver patch (PR #6621). Needs one more review and a smoke test.

Lina: I'm on the canary logs now, looks like a mem spike when batch size hits 8 for certain seq lengths. Reproducing locally.

Ken: @Lina thanks — if you can repro, can you add a minimal repro snippet here? If not, we'll roll a short patch to reduce max batch size for canary route.

Lina: Minimal repro pasted:
```
python reproduce.py --model model-v2 --batch 8 --seq 2048 --requests 50
# triggers mem jump after ~30s
```

Sara: Ack. I'll temporarily lower canary concurrency to 2 and rerun canary traffic. Rolling change in 5m.

ci-bot: Deploy job started: deploy/train-canary-adjust (run 1843). Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/1843 :rocket:

Jamal: PR link for driver patch: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/6621 — added smoke script, seeking one more approver. @Arian can you take a quick look?

Arian: On it, will review in 10m. If all green we'll gate the cut behind the driver merge + canary stabilization.

Ken: Blockers summary: (1) canary instability (investigating mem spike) (2) GPU driver patch awaiting 1 review. Plan: Lina to confirm repro+mitigation, Sara to throttle canary, Jamal to get driver PR approval. If both clear we'll proceed with cut.

Sara: Throttle applied, canary traffic reduced. Observing for 15m.

Lina: Repro confirmed. Working on patch to cap batch size when seq > 1024. Will open PR in next 20m.

Jamal: Noted. I'm standing by to run the post-merge smoke and cut readiness checklist.

Ken: Great. If anything unexpected appears ping here. Otherwise we'll reconvene ~30m before cut for final thumbs. :thumbsup:

Arian: Reviewed infra PR, left one minor comment. Should be quick to resolve.

ci-bot: Deploy job finished: deploy/train-canary-adjust — status: success.

Sara: Canary metrics looking better after throttle. 95%ile latency back to baseline.

Ken: Thanks team — keep updates concise here. I'll post final go/no-go at ~2482010299.
